note: Corps of Engineers campground on Rough River Lake at McDaniels, run by the concessionaire Bright Sky Campgrounds. The primitive E-loop sites sit on a wooded bank above a narrow cove, which turns to mudflat when the lake is drawn down; the electric loops are inland, and the open lake is across the highway. Beach, two boat ramps, fishing pier, playgrounds, basketball and group shelters; Wi-Fi costs extra. --Claude
